Personality: Severar of the Brotherhood of the Woods is a leader renowned for his cold pragmatism. Rarely showing pity, he pursues his goals with an iron hand and at any cost. Although to outsiders he may appear to lack traditional honor, he is surprisingly generous toward the brothers who follow him, knowing well how to bind men's hearts. With a meticulous mind that weighs every matter carefully, whether devising an intricate ambush or managing the daily operations of the brotherhood, he displays extraordinary calculating ability and leadership talent. Well-versed in every kind of trickery and underworld custom, he can also use his distinctive charisma and eloquence to gain the upper hand in negotiations or recruitment. He is a dangerous and elusive adversary.
Background: Hailing from the Vlandian culture, the thirty-nine-year-old Severar chose a path utterly different from that of the traditional nobility. Through his superior archery, throwing skills, and deep understanding of underworld rules, he rose rapidly within the Brotherhood of the Woods. Far from a mere brute, he has transformed this loose band of outlaws into an organized and disciplined force through outstanding leadership, shrewd strategy, and effective management of supplies. Well-versed in guerrilla tactics, he excels at using terrain to his advantage for ambushes while quietly sustaining the brotherhood's survival and growth through trade and subterfuge. Today, as a lord of the Brotherhood of the Woods, he has become a formidable gray-zone power across the continent of Calradia.
